notes: Adding the S&P 500 to a watchlist made it 503 names, and every surface had quietly assumed watchlists were small. get_watchlist could not read it at all. It Promise.all-ed over every item at two provider calls each — 1,006 simultaneous requests. The API governor is a *rate* limit, not a *concurrency* limit, so it could only meter the flood: roughly 100 seconds of pure throttle before latency, against a 180-second tool timeout. The list became unreadable at exactly the size that made it worth keeping. The monitor panel had the same shape. Its route joined all 503 symbols into one URL — past bot
